---
title: "Literature Review Protocol"
format: html
---

## Review question

What statistical methods have been used to detect and attribute changes in the marginal, multivariate and spatial dependence structures of climate extremes, and what methodological gaps remain?

## Include

- non-stationary univariate extremes
- dynamic tail dependence
- compound climate events
- spatial extremes and spatial concurrence
- sequential compound events
- attribution of extreme-event probabilities
- decomposition of marginal and dependence changes

## Exclude

- trend maps with no inferential treatment of extremes
- impact-only studies with no statistical hazard model
- purely descriptive threshold counts where dependence is central but unmodelled

## Screening

Record search source, search date, query, inclusion decision and reason for exclusion. Populate `evidence_matrix.csv` only after full-text screening.
